newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish SIPTU welcomes intervention in ambulance row.
newsitem.headline: Irish SIPTU welcomes intervention in ambulance row.

text.p: Irish union body SIPTU said on Wednesday that it had accepted an invitation to talks at the Labour Relations Commission on Thursday to discuss a proposed ambulance service dispute.
"SIPTU has accepted this invitation and has welcomed the intervention of the Labour Relations Commission," SIPTU Regional Secretary, Brendan Hayes said in a statement.
Hayes said action by the minister for health to ensure a concentrated effort to address the issues at the centre of the dispute involving provincial ambulance services would be helpful at this point.

SIPTU earlier warned of a serious disruption to the emergency ambulance service from Monday next following failure of the Employers on Friday last to put froward "realistic proposals for the provision of emergency cover during the upcoming strike action by Provincial Ambulance Personnel".
